# Project instructions

## MOST IMPORTANT INSTRUCTION 

- Try to be the least verbose possible in your answers. Don't be too verbose, don't explain too much, except if specifically asked.
  Always prefer short answers! 

## Language
- Answer in French or English, depending on the language used in the question :
  if the question is in English, answer in English; if the question is in French, answer in French.
  Do it for any mode (Ask, Plan, Agent, etc.).
- Always use English in the code base (code + comments).
